name: career_episode_retrieval_zh_v1
purpose: Compare lexical-only episode retrieval (FTS5 trigram BM25 + LIKE) with lexical + embedding + RRF on Chinese queries. Synthetic single-user corpus; labels are defined by user intent, independent of any retrieval method.

run_modes.projection: SQLiteCareerEpisodeStore.project_relevant(query=user_message): CJK runs are split into overlapping trigrams and OR-ed.
run_modes.tool_keywords: SQLiteCareerEpisodeStore.search(query=tool_query, kinds/start/end from filters): what a well-behaved model would pass.
run_modes.tool_sentence: SQLiteCareerEpisodeStore.search(query=user_message, same filters): simulates a model passing the raw sentence; an unsegmented Chinese sentence becomes one token and needs a contiguous match.

metrics.answerable: Recall@5 and nDCG@5 using graded relevance (2 = target, 1 = acceptable).
metrics.unanswerable: For queries with an empty relevant set: report whether anything is returned and whether top-1 is a near_miss or same-domain decoy. Lexical OR matching usually returns something, so the decisive check is top-1 entity correctness, not emptiness.
metrics.slices: Report every metric per category and per run mode; a global average hides the alias and paraphrase slices where the two methods are expected to differ.

corpus_notes: Titles follow services/episode_consolidation.py (company · role, '· 第 N 轮面试'). Summaries mimic tool receipts for application/interview_round/job_research and the assistant reply for mock_interview; all <= 400 chars (EPISODE_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS).
